newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline volatile with futures.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline volatile with futures.

text.p: NWE gasoline ended Thursday little changed after futures markets took physical prices on a rodeo ride, traders said.

Around 150,000 tonnes of mixed grades were sold across the Atlantic on Wednesday. One U.K.-based player was heard selling a cargo with 40,000 tonnes of M4 87 octane gasoline at Oct NYMEX -6.5 cents, and 20,000 tonnes of V4 93 octane at Oct -2.5 cts.
A French-based refiner sold 28,000 tonnes of 48 grade, 87 octane gasoline at October -8.65 cents. An ARA refiner also sold 60,000 tonnes of mixed grades on Wednesday.
